origins.section: 8.1. Track Data, PIN Blocks and Security Codes Are Never Kept, and a Card Number Only Unreadable
8.4. Every Key Is Encrypted Under the Key Above It, and Known by Its Check Value
8.5. DUKPT Gives Every Purchase Its Own Key, Derived From a Serial Number Sent Beside the PIN
8.7. TLS Protects One Connection, and the PIN Block and the MAC Protect the Message

gates.says: all 4 of this quiz's answerable readings held and each was taken over the question as it stands

recorded.prompt:q-retry-file: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-retry-file: independent readers: one with the page (Q1, Q3), one with the question's text only (Q2)
recorded.outcome:q-retry-file: 8.1 says a copied encrypted PIN block with track 2 can pass the issuer's PIN check without anyone knowing the PIN, and its table marks fields 35 and 52 never keep, even encrypted, which supports option c.
recorded.prompt:q-two-hsms: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-two-hsms: independent readers: one with the page (Q1, Q3), one with the question's text only (Q2)
recorded.outcome:q-two-hsms: 8.4 defines the check value as zeros encrypted under the key, says the same key has different bytes under two HSMs' LMKs, and says to compare check values rather than bytes, which supports option a.
recorded.prompt:q-dukpt-blocks: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-dukpt-blocks: independent readers: one with the page (Q1, Q3), one with the question's text only (Q2)
recorded.outcome:q-dukpt-blocks: 8.5 says the pad advances the KSN counter for every PIN, encrypts each PIN under that counter's key, and the same clear block went out under three keys, which supports option d.
recorded.prompt:q-load-balancer: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-load-balancer: independent readers: one with the page (Q1, Q3), one with the question's text only (Q2)
recorded.outcome:q-load-balancer: 8.7 says TLS ends at the load balancer and the receiving application's MAC check proves nothing in between changed the message, which supports option c.

gates.says: all 12 of this quiz's discriminating readings held and each was taken over the question as it stands

recorded.prompt:q-retry-file:a: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-retry-file:a: independent readers: one with the page (Q1, Q3), one with the question's text only (Q2)
recorded.outcome:q-retry-file:a: 8.1 shows the block is misused as it is, copied into a new purchase, so nobody has to decrypt it into a PIN.
recorded.prompt:q-retry-file:b: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-retry-file:b: independent readers: one with the page (Q1, Q3), one with the question's text only (Q2)
recorded.outcome:q-retry-file:b: 8.1 says the copied block passes the PIN check until its key changes, not until its own purchase is answered.
recorded.prompt:q-retry-file:d: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-retry-file:d: independent readers: one with the page (Q1, Q3), one with the question's text only (Q2)
recorded.outcome:q-retry-file:d: 8.1 limits masking to the card number (field 2) and says field 52 is never kept, even encrypted.
recorded.prompt:q-two-hsms:b: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-two-hsms:b: independent readers: one with the page (Q1, Q3), one with the question's text only (Q2)
recorded.outcome:q-two-hsms:b: 8.4 shows a mistyped component being accepted and only the check value revealing it.
recorded.prompt:q-two-hsms:c: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-two-hsms:c: independent readers: one with the page (Q1, Q3), one with the question's text only (Q2)
recorded.outcome:q-two-hsms:c: 8.4 says under two HSMs' LMKs the same key has different bytes.
recorded.prompt:q-two-hsms:d: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-two-hsms:d: independent readers: one with the page (Q1, Q3), one with the question's text only (Q2)
recorded.outcome:q-two-hsms:d: 8.4 computes the check value under the key itself and says to compare check values because the LMK bytes differ.
recorded.prompt:q-dukpt-blocks:a: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-dukpt-blocks:a: independent readers: one with the page (Q1, Q3), one with the question's text only (Q2)
recorded.outcome:q-dukpt-blocks:a: 8.5 says the host's HSM derives each key from the BDK and the KSN, so no key is stored per pad.
recorded.prompt:q-dukpt-blocks:b: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-dukpt-blocks:b: independent readers: one with the page (Q1, Q3), one with the question's text only (Q2)
recorded.outcome:q-dukpt-blocks:b: 8.3 says a format 0 block is the same only under one key, and 8.5 shows DUKPT changes the key for each purchase (partly true premise).
recorded.prompt:q-dukpt-blocks:c: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-dukpt-blocks:c: independent readers: one with the page (Q1, Q3), one with the question's text only (Q2)
recorded.outcome:q-dukpt-blocks:c: 8.2 and 8.3 say format 0 fills with F and random fill belongs to format 3.
recorded.prompt:q-load-balancer:a: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-load-balancer:a: independent readers: one with the page (Q1, Q3), one with the question's text only (Q2)
recorded.outcome:q-load-balancer:a: 8.7 says the message travels in clear after the load balancer, so TLS does not cover it there (partly true: TLS does protect its own connection).
recorded.prompt:q-load-balancer:b: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-load-balancer:b: independent readers: one with the page (Q1, Q3), one with the question's text only (Q2)
recorded.outcome:q-load-balancer:b: 8.6 says that without a MAC the altered message is well-formed and the host approves 450.00.
recorded.prompt:q-load-balancer:d: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-load-balancer:d: independent readers: one with the page (Q1, Q3), one with the question's text only (Q2)
recorded.outcome:q-load-balancer:d: 8.6 says a MAC hides none of the bytes, and 8.7 credits TLS, not the MAC, with keeping the card number unreadable.

gates.says: each of the 4 questions keys exactly 1 of its distinct options and every option carries the sentence its reader is shown
each of the 4 questions cites a passage the ledger still digests to the value this exercise was built from
